## API Gateway Setup

### Overview
Set up the API Gateway to handle authentication, rate limiting, and routing for all microservices.

### Tasks
- [ ] Evaluate Kong vs Nginx vs AWS API Gateway
- [ ] Set up chosen API Gateway locally
- [ ] Configure service routing rules
- [ ] Implement JWT validation middleware
- [ ] Add rate limiting per endpoint
- [ ] Configure CORS policies
- [ ] Set up request/response logging
- [ ] Add health check endpoints
- [ ] Configure load balancing
- [ ] Create gateway documentation
- [ ] Set up monitoring dashboard
- [ ] Create Docker compose configuration

### Acceptance Criteria
- All service endpoints accessible through gateway
- JWT tokens validated on protected routes
- Rate limiting prevents abuse
- Health checks return proper status
- Logs capture all requests
- Documentation complete

### Dependencies
- Identity Service (for JWT validation)

### Estimated Time
- 1 week

### References
- [Architecture Doc](ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [Kong Documentation](https://docs.konghq.com/)

comments.body:
## 🎉 API Gateway Implementation Status

Great news! After reviewing the codebase, the API Gateway setup is **essentially complete**. Here's the detailed status:

### ✅ Completed Tasks

| Task | Status | Implementation |
|------|--------|----------------|
| Evaluate Kong vs Nginx vs AWS API Gateway | ✅ | Kong selected and configured |
| Set up chosen API Gateway locally | ✅ | `gateway/kong.yml` + Docker Compose |
| Configure service routing rules | ✅ | Routes for all 4 services defined |
| Implement JWT validation middleware | ✅ | JWT plugin configured on protected routes |
| Add rate limiting per endpoint | ✅ | Different limits per endpoint category |
| Configure CORS policies | ✅ | Permissive dev config, prod templates ready |
| Set up request/response logging | ✅ | File-log plugin configured |
| Add health check endpoints | ✅ | Health checks on all upstream services |
| Configure load balancing | ✅ | Round-robin with service discovery |
| Create gateway documentation | ✅ | `gateway/README.md` complete |
| Create Docker compose configuration | ✅ | Full stack in `docker-compose.yml` |

### ⚠️ Remaining
| Task | Status | Notes |
|------|--------|-------|
| Set up monitoring dashboard | 🔄 | Grafana configured, needs Kong-specific dashboard |

### Key Files
- `gateway/kong.yml` - Main Kong declarative config
- `gateway/README.md` - Gateway documentation  
- `docker-compose.yml` - Full infrastructure including Kong

### Access Points
- **Proxy**: `http://localhost:8000`
- **Admin API**: `http://localhost:8001`
- **Manager GUI**: `http://localhost:8002`

---

**Recommendation**: This issue can be closed once the monitoring dashboard is verified. The core API Gateway functionality is production-ready! 🚀

## Identity Service Implementation

### Overview
Implement the foundation service for user authentication and KYC verification.

### Tasks
- [ ] Set up Node.js/Express project structure
- [ ] Configure PostgreSQL database with migrations
- [ ] Implement user registration API
- [ ] Add JWT authentication
- [ ] Create login/logout endpoints

- [ ] Create user profile management APIs
- [ ] Add multi-language support (en, pcm, yo, fr)

- [ ] Add integration tests
- [ ] Create Dockerfile
- [ ] Update OpenAPI documentation

- Users can register with email/phone
- Users can login and receive JWT token
- Users can upload KYC documents
- All APIs follow OpenAPI spec
- Tests pass with >80% coverage

### Dependencies
- None (foundation service)

### Estimated Time
- 2 weeks

### References
- [Service README](services/identity-service/README.md)
- [OpenAPI Spec](services/identity-service/openapi.yaml)
- [Architecture Doc](ARCHITECTURE.md)

## API Gateway Setup

### Overview
Set up the API Gateway to handle authentication, rate limiting, and routing for all microservices.

### Tasks
- [ ] Evaluate Kong vs Nginx vs AWS API Gateway
- [ ] Set up chosen API Gateway locally
- [ ] Configure service routing rules
- [ ] Implement JWT validation middleware
- [ ] Add rate limiting per endpoint
- [ ] Configure CORS policies
- [ ] Set up request/response logging
- [ ] Add health check endpoints
- [ ] Configure load balancing
- [ ] Create gateway documentation
- [ ] Set up monitoring dashboard
- [ ] Create Docker compose configuration

### Acceptance Criteria
- All service endpoints accessible through gateway
- JWT tokens validated on protected routes
- Rate limiting prevents abuse
- Health checks return proper status
- Logs capture all requests
- Documentation complete

### Dependencies
- Identity Service (for JWT validation)

### Estimated Time
- 1 week

### References
- [Architecture Doc](ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [Kong Documentation](https://docs.konghq.com/)
